geographic_measure: occupied latitude-longitude cells and HUC2 station counts, not drainage area or all-US-river coverage
hot_year_interpretation: descriptive frequencies on each rule's available annual values; incomplete-year classifications are model/statistic dependent, not verified natural-gap events
hot_year_reference: same approved complete-year reference threshold for all methods at a station; no estimated values in threshold fitting
role: exploratory national source analysis; fixed before full country summaries, not a public registration
